sources.facts: Regional cultural register RNCB.20161228.02.001363. Main Karsten hall, 3.25 m gate, 16.25 m by 12.4 m original pavilion, 2.1 m transition, two-storey west secretary wing, red tile and 20 m by 21 m arts pavilion with three joglo tiers.
Official museum history identifies the traditional Karsten joglo building and the original November 1935 opening.
Museum site confirms historic Unit I on the north side of Alun-alun and south entrance from Jalan Trikora No. 6.
The Finance Ministry reports reopened gallery exhibition in the standing Thomas Karsten building in 2024.
